Northstar Commerce | Synthetic operating policy
Each dispute requires a human reviewer. Support owns the decision.
Finance supplies order and payment evidence.
Refund authorisation requires an approved finance operator.

recommendations.title: Refund routing
recommendations.action: Route validated refund requests to finance
recommendations.observed: 132 matching events across 132 cases. Median preceding interval 31.15 hours.
recommendations.inference: The refunds team may benefit from a controlled pilot.
recommendations.limitations: Timestamps measure elapsed time. Staffing effort, exception rates and financial benefit require field validation.
roadmap: Validate source identifiers and review cited cases
Pilot in shadow mode with a named owner
Review mismatches and authorise controlled rollout
